backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on signal date. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The pressure resilience candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: compression-to-expansion with volume and a high close can capture accumulation starts after volatility has contracted, potentially expanding the candidate pool without noisy ticker additions.

2_history_check.exp-20260606-014: Broad 5-day winner exhaustion cap was rejected despite positive aggregate because old_thin regressed, drawdown stayed high, and it underperformed the accepted ETF substitute.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-015: Low-volatility 20-day high breakout was rejected: aggregate EV +0.5989 but mid_weak and old_thin regressed and drawdown drift hit +2.61pp.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-010/012/014: Industry breadth/dispersion/volume-breadth variants were rejected; this run tests single-name compression-to-expansion rather than industry participation retunes.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-010: Core-flow confirmed industry volume-breadth repair was rejected as too sparse and non-incremental.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window, target sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard passes.

hypothesis: Narrow-range volatility compression followed by a signal-day range-expansion close near the high may identify liquid stock accumulation starts with better next-open 10-day replacement value than raw broad momentum.
interpretation: The narrow-range compression breakout source cleared Gate 4 as a replay-only/default-off lead, but no production surface was promoted. A shared parity adapter is required before use.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that narrow-range compression breakout is still a broad OHLCV momentum/liquidity relabel. The frozen-window history already shows nearby broad 5-day winner, low-vol breakout, industry breadth, and volume-breadth candidate sources fail robustness or drawdown gates; do not answer by sweeping range, volume, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on these same windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially new evidence such as forward replacement-value rows, a production-visible catalyst/flow provenance layer, or a PIT breadth-persistence field. Pure OHLCV compression/breakout threshold retunes should stay frozen.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping range-compression lookback, range-expansion ratio, volume, close-location, ret5/ret20, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on these frozen windows. Also avoid relabeling this as another volatility-contraction/VCP retune without a direct shared helper reconciliation.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Next useful evidence is a shared default-off helper that reproduces this exact historical replay and daily snapshot semantics, plus closed forward replacement-value rows. A production/live activation would need a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4 with capital caps, liquidity and slippage assumptions, exposure limits, displacement, and kill switch rules.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The fixed compression-to-expansion source improved all three windows because it selected only 44 liquid top-ranked rows after prior range compression, signal-day range expansion, volume, high-close, SPY-relative trend, and overextension controls. The edge is small, so it should be treated as a positive replay lead rather than live-ready alpha until shared daily parity and forward replacement rows prove the same behavior outside the frozen windows.

prediction.confidence_reason: Recent broad OHLCV and industry-breadth neighbors mostly failed, but this tests a distinct compression-to-expansion accumulation structure with production-visible fields and no LLM/proxy data dependency.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter that computes the same sector-known liquid stock universe, prior narrow-range compression fields, signal-day range expansion, close-location, volume confirmation, SPY-relative trend guards, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
